summary: Cardlytics filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026, disclosing a September 4, 2026 settlement and release agreement with Amit Jain, founder and former CEO/director of acquired Bridg, Inc. The pact resolves Delaware Chancery litigation (Case No. 2026-0896-TJF) over advancement and indemnification tied to the DailyGobble Action and Scottsdale Insurance coverage disputes. Aggregate settlement totals $6.4 million: Jain's roughly $5.3 million allocated DailyGobble share plus $1.1 million legal fees, matching the $6.5 million June 30, 2026 accrual. Cardlytics is pursuing insurance reimbursement. This is a routine litigation settlement, not a special situation.
